scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const b = spawn('npm', ['start', '--prefix', 'backend'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); const f = spawn('npm', ['start', '--prefix', 'frontend'], { stdio: 'inherit' }); const cleanup = () => { b.kill(); f.kill(); process.exit(); }; process.on('SIGINT', cleanup); process.on('SIGTERM', cleanup);"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix backend && npm test --prefix frontend -- --watch=false
